common.name: Name
common.discardMessage: What you filled in won't be saved.

sheet.grabberHint: Drag up to expand or down to close

home.subtitle: Your summary for {{month}}
home.step1: Add your salary and fixed bills (rent, internet…) with “Repeat every month”.
home.step2: In Plan, set a limit for each category — together they become your monthly budget.
home.step3: Log everyday spending with the + button and see how much you can still spend.
home.noneThisMonth: No entries this month. Tap + to add one.

dues.empty: Nothing due in the next few days. All good!

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.off: Alerts are turned off in Settings › Alerts.
alerts.allClear: Nothing due in the next {{days}} days and no category close to its limit.

stats.title: Statistics
stats.noPrev: No data from last month to compare.
stats.byTagHint: Entries also tagged with another category (e.g. everything paid by Card). They are not added to the total again.

plan.title: Planning
plan.subtitle: Budget, upcoming installments and goals
plan.noLimitsTitle: You haven't set any limits yet
plan.noLimitsText: Drag the dot of each category below. The monthly budget is the sum of the limits — with it, the home screen shows how much you can still spend per day.
plan.limitsHint: Drag the dot to adjust the limit (all the way left = no limit). For an exact amount, edit the category in Settings.
plan.installmentsNextIncome: In {{month}}, installments add up to {{value}} ({{pct}} of this month's income).
plan.recurringNextWithIncome: Recurring in {{month}}: {{expenses}} in bills · {{income}} in income

limit.spentNoLimit: {{spent}} spent · drag to set a limit

goals.title: Goals
goals.emptyText: Save up for an emergency fund, a trip or a big purchase.
goals.emptyTextInvest: Create goals and link your investments: their current value counts toward progress automatically.
goals.contributeHint: Add here what you saved outside your investments (linked investments already count on their own).
goals.deleteMessage: "{{name}}" and the amount saved separately in it ({{value}}) will be removed.
goals.deleteLinkedNote: Linked investments stay in your portfolio.
goals.targetLabel: How much you want to save
goals.targetError: Enter how much you want to save.
goals.savedHint: Money saved outside the investments you registered (optional).
goals.linkedEmpty: Add investments in the Investments app to link them to this goal.
goals.linkedHint: They add up to {{value}} now and count toward progress. * = linked to another goal (selecting it here moves the link).

form.valueError: Enter an amount greater than zero.
form.mainCategoryHint: This is the one that counts in the budget and charts.
form.alsoInHint: Optional: helps filter and total in the statement and statistics, without counting twice in the budget.
form.cardAuto: On credit, the “Card” tag is added automatically (you can remove it).
form.repeatFrom: Shows up automatically every month starting {{date}}.
form.installmentHint: Splits the total into monthly installments
form.dueError: The due date can't be before the entry date.
form.deleteMessage: "{{name}}" will be removed. You can undo right after.
form.deleteMessageRecurring: "{{name}}" will be removed from all months. You can undo right after.

category.duplicateError: A category with this name already exists.
category.limitHint: Leave {{zero}} for no limit. The monthly budget is the sum of the limits.
category.inUse: There are entries with "{{name}}" as their main category. Change their category or delete them first — or just rename this category.
category.lastOfKindExpense: "{{name}}" is the only expense category. Create another one before deleting it.
category.lastOfKindIncome: "{{name}}" is the only income category. Create another one before deleting it.
category.fixed: "{{name}}" is a system category and can't be deleted.
category.fixedNote: System category: the name is fixed, but you can change the icon, type and limit.
category.deleteTagNote: It is also removed from the tags of your entries.

account.balanceNote: The balance is for reference: update it whenever you check with your bank.
account.cardSubtitle: Limit {{limit}} · closes on day {{close}} · due on day {{due}}

settings.title: Settings
settings.accountsEmpty: Add your accounts and cards to keep track of balances and limits.
settings.categoriesHint: Tap a category to rename it or change its icon, suggested type or monthly limit. “Card” is a system category and becomes an automatic tag on credit purchases.
settings.dueAlertsHint: Show in the home screen bell what is due in the next 7 days
settings.budgetAlertsHint: Show in the bell the categories above 80% of their limit
settings.biometricsHint: Ask for fingerprint or Face ID when opening the app
settings.biometricsNotEnrolled: Set up a fingerprint or Face ID in your device settings. (Not available on the web version.)
settings.hideValuesHint: Home and Portfolio open with amounts hidden. The eye shows them only until you leave the screen.
settings.dataHint: Your data is stored only on this device. Export reports if you want a copy.
settings.eraseMessage: Entries, accounts, cards, goals, custom categories and your whole investment portfolio will be erased from this device. This can't be undone.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.autoHint: In automatic, the app follows your device's light/dark mode. Applies to both apps.
appearance.pickerHint: Drag to choose. The color is applied when you let go; text and buttons adjust their contrast automatically.

language.title: Language
language.note: Amounts stay in Brazilian reais (R$); separators and dates follow the chosen language.

lock.title: App locked
lock.text: Use your biometrics to see your finances.
lock.error: We couldn't confirm your identity. Try again.

welcome.tagline: Two apps in one: your monthly budget and your investments — see where your money goes and how much it earns.
welcome.f1Title: How much you can spend today
welcome.f1Text: Budget by category, with installments and fixed bills entered only once.
welcome.f2Text: Each expense has a main category and can also show up in others (e.g. Card).
welcome.f3Text: Fixed and variable income, automatic quotes, dividends and income tax — and goals fill up on their own.
welcome.footer: You enter your transactions, investments and goals. Everything is stored only on this device.

export.title: Export
export.budgetRowHint: Monthly or yearly, with income and spending totals · CSV or PDF
export.investRowHint: Monthly or yearly, with returns, dividends and tax · CSV or PDF
export.pdfHint: A report ready to read, print or send.
export.csvHint: To open in Excel, Google Sheets or Numbers.
export.budgetContents: Includes totals, categories, tags, payment methods and entries (yearly: month by month, averages, biggest expenses and comparison with the previous year).
export.investContents: Includes starting and ending net worth, contributions, withdrawals, dividends, realized gains, estimated tax, positions at cost and transactions.
export.unavailableMessage: This device doesn't allow sharing files.
export.errorMessage: Please try again in a moment.
export.generatedAt: Generated on {{date}} by Dinheiro em Dia. Amounts in Brazilian reais (R$).

typeHints.cdb: Bank certificate of deposit · covered by FGC (deposit insurance)
typeHints.lci: Real estate credit note · income-tax free · FGC
typeHints.lca: Agribusiness credit note · income-tax free · FGC
typeHints.tesouro_selic: Brazilian government bond tied to Selic (the central bank rate)
typeHints.tesouro_prefixado: Brazilian government bond with a fixed rate
typeHints.tesouro_ipca: Brazilian government bond: inflation (IPCA) + a rate
typeHints.poupanca: Pays 0.5% a month (+TR) while Selic is above 8.5%
typeHints.fundo_di: Fund that tracks the CDI (interbank rate)
typeHints.fii: Automatic quote from B3 · monthly distributions
typeHints.fundo: Multi-market, equity, currency… (value entered by you)
typeHints.outro: Any other investment (value entered by you)

opHints.compra: Quantity × price; brokerage costs go into the average price.
opHints.venda: Profit is calculated from the average price (Brazilian tax rule).
opHints.resgate: Gross amount withdrawn; gains are taken proportionally (oldest first).
opHints.provento: Dividends, JCP, FII distributions, interest or amortization received.
opHints.desdobramento: E.g. from 1 to 2 — the quantity doubles and the average price halves.
opHints.grupamento: E.g. from 10 to 1 — the quantity drops and the average price rises.
opHints.bonificacao: Free shares received, with the cost stated by the company.
opHints.taxa: Custody, management or other fee paid.

status.offline: No connection — using the last saved values.
status.needsToken_one: {{count}} B3 asset without a quote: the free brapi token is missing.
status.needsToken_other: {{count}} B3 assets without a quote: the free brapi token is missing.

portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.subtitle: Your investments
portfolio.step1: Add each investment (CDB, government bonds, stocks, FIIs, crypto…) with its initial contribution or purchase.
portfolio.step2: Record later transactions with the + button: buys, sells, contributions, withdrawals and income.
portfolio.step3: Link investments to your goals — their value fills the goal on its own.
portfolio.ratesTip: The rates (CDI, Selic, IPCA) haven't been updated from the Brazilian Central Bank yet — tap to see.
portfolio.tokenTip: To get quotes for {{list}}, add the free brapi.dev token. Tap to set it up.
portfolio.goalsEmpty: Create goals in the Goals tab and link investments to them.
portfolio.goalsLinkTip: No investment linked to goals yet. Link them from the investment or from the goal.

evolution.hint: Touch and drag on the chart to see each month. Past net worth comes from the monthly snapshots the app saves when you open the Portfolio.

incomeScreen.title: Income
incomeScreen.subtitle: Dividends, JCP, distributions and interest
incomeScreen.barsHint: Tap a bar to see the amount. Best month: {{max}}.
incomeScreen.withholdingNote: Since 2026, dividends above R$ 50k in a month from the same company have 10% income tax withheld: {{list}}.

goalsScreen.subtitle: The same goals as in Budget
goalsScreen.howItWorks: Each goal's progress = what you saved separately + the current value of linked investments. When it reaches the target, the goal completes on its own.

more.ratesHint: CDI, Selic, IPCA and API keys
more.rebalanceHint: Target allocation and where to invest next
more.simulatorHint: Compound interest and time to your goal
more.taxHint: Tax on sales, DARF and yearly summary
more.institutionsHint: Banks, brokers and the FGC limit
more.autoRefreshHint: Quotes every 15 min and rates every 12 h, when online.

form.tickerHint: Tap Search to check the ticker and fetch its name and price.
form.lookupError: Couldn't search right now (invalid ticker, no token or no internet). You can fill it in manually.
form.coinError: Search for and choose the coin.

rateHint.cdi: E.g. 110 for 110% of CDI (the Brazilian interbank rate).

form.poupancaHint: Savings pay on the monthly anniversary: 0.5% a month (+TR) while Selic is above 8.5%; otherwise, 70% of Selic.
form.maturityError: The maturity must be after the contribution.
form.dailyLiquidityHint: Can be withdrawn at any time
form.costsHint: Optional. They go into the average price.
form.valueError: Enter an amount greater than zero.
form.institutionPlaceholder: E.g. XP, Nubank, Banco do Brasil

opForm.deleteMessage: The investment's position and result will be recalculated.
opForm.sellTooMuch: You only hold {{qty}} on this date.
opForm.irError: The tax can't exceed the gross amount.
opForm.factorHint: Event ratio: e.g. split from 1 to 2, reverse split from 10 to 1.
opForm.bonusCostHint: Amount stated by the company (goes into the average price).

detail.setPriceHint: Used until a more recent automatic quote arrives.
detail.setValueHint: Use the value from your institution's statement. Later contributions and withdrawals are added to it.
detail.setValueFixedHint: Adjusts the calculation to your bank statement; from that date on, it keeps growing by the index.
detail.fixedInfo: Value calculated from the index ("accrual"). If your bank shows a different value, enter it to adjust.
detail.manualInfo: This type has no automatic quote: enter the current value from time to time.
detail.deleteMessage_one: The investment and {{count}} transaction will be removed.
detail.deleteMessage_other: The investment and {{count}} transactions will be removed.

rates.title: Reference rates
rates.series: Saved series: {{cdi}} days of CDI, {{selic}} of Selic, {{ipca}} months of IPCA.
rates.manualHint: Offline or prefer other values? Enter the yearly rates (%). They apply to days without official data yet.
rates.brapiHint: Free with sign-up at brapi.dev (paste the token here). Without a token, only PETR4, VALE3, MGLU3 and ITUB4 get quotes.
rates.coingeckoHint: Works without a key. A free Demo key (coingecko.com) raises the request limit.
rates.keyOk: Connection OK — key saved in the device's secure storage.
rates.keyFail: It didn't work. Check the key and your internet connection.

rebalance.intro: Set how much you want in each class. The app suggests where to put your next contribution to get closer to the target, without selling anything.

sim.breakdown: You invest {{invested}} and interest adds up to {{interest}}.
sim.never: With these values, you won't get there in 100 years.
sim.needed: To get there in {{years}} years: contribute {{value}} per month.
sim.disclaimer: Simulation with gross values (no tax, fees or inflation) and a constant rate. Useful for comparing scenarios — not a promise of returns.

tax.disclaimer: Estimate for reference (regular trades, no day trading), under the 2026 Brazilian rules: stocks are exempt up to R$ 20k in sales per month, otherwise 15%; ETFs and BDRs 15%; FIIs 20%; crypto is exempt up to R$ 35k in sales per month, otherwise 15%. Check with your accountant or the Receita Federal software.
tax.yearTotal: Estimated DARF (tax payment slip) for the year: {{value}}
tax.exemptStocks: Exempt stock profit (sales up to R$ 20k/month)
tax.dividendWithholding: Note: dividends above R$ 50k in a month from the same company have 10% withheld (Law 15,270/2025): {{list}}.
tax.positionsHint: The “Bens e Direitos” (assets) section of the Brazilian tax return uses the acquisition cost, not the market value.

institutions.intro: The FGC (Brazilian deposit insurance) covers up to {{limit}} per person at each institution (CDB, LCI, LCA, LC, savings). See how much you have at each one.
institutions.deleteMessage: Its investments will have no institution.

report.returnNote: Result = appreciation + income. Approximate return (Dietz method).
report.estimatedNote: * Estimated (no monthly snapshot for that date): fixed income recalculated from the index and variable income at cost.
